extracted_concepts.name: L'Hôpital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If lim f = lim g = 0 (or ∞) and lim f'/g' exists, then lim f/g = lim f'/g'

extracted_concepts.name: Indeterminate Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expressions like 0/0, ∞/∞, 0·∞, ∞−∞, 1^∞, 0^0, ∞^0 that require special limit techniques

extracted_concepts.name: 0/0 Indeterminate Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where lim f(x) = lim g(x) = 0; apply L'Hôpital if lim f'/g' exists

extracted_concepts.name: ∞/∞ Indeterminate Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where lim f(x) = lim g(x) = ∞; apply L'Hôpital if lim f'/g' exists

extracted_concepts.name: 0·∞ Indeterminate Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rewrite as 0/(1/∞) or ∞/(1/0) to convert to 0/0 or ∞/∞

extracted_concepts.name: ∞−∞ Indeterminate Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Combine fractions to convert into a quotient form

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Indeterminate Forms
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Forms 1^∞, 0^0, ∞^0 handled by taking logarithm then applying L'Hôpital

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The value a function approaches; computed via L'Hôpital for indeterminate quotients

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change of f; L'Hôpital replaces f/g by f'/g'

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio of Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The quotient f'/g' whose limit must exist for L'Hôpital's Rule to apply

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithmic Transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Take logarithm of exponential indeterminate forms, then apply L'Hôpital

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor's Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f has n+1 derivatives near a, f(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x−a) + ... + R_n

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Power series of f about a using all higher-order derivatives at a

extracted_concepts.name: Maclaurin Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Taylor series centered at a = 0

extracted_concepts.name: Remainder Term R_n
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Error term R_n that determines the accuracy of the polynomial approximation

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: First-order approximation f(x) ≈ f(a) + f'(a)(x−a), generalized by Taylor series

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximating f by a Taylor polynomial whose accuracy is set by R_n

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: e^x = Σ xⁿ/n! for all x

extracted_concepts.name: Sine Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: sin x = Σ (−1)ⁿx²ⁿ⁺¹/(2n+1)! for all x

extracted_concepts.name: Cosine Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: cos x = Σ (−1)ⁿx²ⁿ/(2n)! for all x

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 1/(1−x) = Σ xⁿ for |x| < 1

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithmic Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ln(1+x) = Σ (−1)ⁿ⁻¹xⁿ/n for −1 < x ≤ 1

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of infinitely many terms; Taylor series unifies it with differentiation and integration

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of computing derivatives; connected to series via Taylor expansion

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of computing integrals; unified with differentiation and series by Taylor series

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-Order Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives f'', f''', ..., f⁽ⁿ⁾ required by Taylor's Theorem

extracted_concepts.name: Interval of Convergence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of x for which a series converges, e.g., |x|<1 for 1/(1−x)
